phone.computers.title: Computers
phone.computers.help: Each one stays connected. Open one to start tasks there.
phone.computers.emptyHow: On your computer, open wisp and choose Machines → Add to your phone, then Add computer here.
phone.key.changed: Its key changed: check before you trust it
phone.key.confirmChanged: This computer’s key is not the one it had. If you didn’t reinstall it or change its SSH keys, someone may be in the way. Trust it only if you know why it changed.
phone.key.confirmPinned: This computer’s key is not the one its QR code showed. Trust it only if you know why it changed.
phone.key.failed: Couldn’t keep the new key. Try again.
phone.add.title: Add computer
phone.add.scanHow: On your computer, open wisp and choose Machines → Add to your phone.
phone.add.manualHow: Type how you reach it over SSH. The first key it shows is kept.
phone.add.noScanner: This phone can’t scan codes here. Type its address instead.
phone.add.denied: The camera is off for wisp. Type its address instead, or allow the camera in Settings.
phone.add.notWisp: That isn’t a wisp code. Type its address instead.
phone.add.name: Name
phone.stay.title: Stay connected
phone.stay.help: Keeps SSH computers connected while wisp is closed, so you hear when a task needs you.
phone.cloud.title: wisp Cloud
phone.cloud.how: Your own wisp on a server: agents keep working when your computers sleep. Sign in once; your cloud wisp and your computers on it show here.
phone.cloud.addressError.insecure: Use https:// for a grid: your sign-in goes over it.
phone.cloud.finishVia: Sign in with {provider}, then tap Allow for this phone. The code there matches this one.
phone.cloud.finishGrid: Open {host}, sign in, and allow the device showing this code.
phone.cloud.waiting: Waiting for you to allow it…
phone.cloud.error.unreachable: Can’t reach {host}. Check your connection and try again.
phone.cloud.error.denied: Sign-in was declined in the browser.
phone.cloud.error.expired: The code expired. Sign in again.
phone.cloud.error.noVault: This phone can’t keep your sign-in safely, so it wasn’t kept.
phone.cloud.error.signedOut: Signed out on {host}. Sign in again.
phone.cloud.signedOut: Signed out of {handle} on this phone
phone.cloud.signedOutLater: Signed out of {handle} on this phone. {host} couldn’t be reached: it’s told the next time the phone connects.
phone.cloud.signedOutUntold: Signed out of {handle} on this phone, but {host} couldn’t be told. Remove this phone on its account page.
phone.cloud.signOutFailed: Signed out of {handle}, but some of its computers are still on this phone.
phone.cloud.signedOutHere: Signed out on this phone. Its computers stay as they were until you sign in again.
phone.cloud.saveFailed: Couldn’t update {handle}’s computers on this phone. Try again.
